metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 2000 · Ginger Snaps
metas.description: Two death-obsessed sisters, outcasts in their suburban neighborhood, must deal with the tragic consequences when one of them is bitten by a deadly werewolf.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2004 · Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
metas.description: Ginger's sister Brigitte, now a werewolf herself, must try to find a cure for her blood lust before the next full moon while hiding out in a rehab clinic from a relentless werewolf.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.8 · 2004 · Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
metas.description: Set in 19th Century Canada, Brigette and her sister Ginger take refuge in a Traders' Fort which later becomes under siege by some savage werewolves.
